messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High latency detected on inference cluster rwd-serving-prod-usw2. Metric: p95 latency > 1200ms for 12m. Error rate stable. Severity: P1. Paging: @Sam (oncall). War room: https://warroom.internal/r/2334456789 :rotating_light:
Sam (oncall): On it. Jumping into war room now. Confirming I'm paged.
Sam (oncall): Quick check — is this affecting all models or a subset?
Marta - Eng: Looks like traffic to the large-encoder pools (model: redwood-13b-q8) has high tail latency. Small models unaffected.
Alex (SRE): seeing CPU GPU scheduling backlog on nodes gw-uw2-{04..07}. Kernel oom? Not seeing OOMs. I'll run live node checks.
Sam (oncall): Thanks. @Marta can you take incident owner until we have a mitigation?
Marta - Eng: I can own. Taking. In war room. I'll toggle canary routing to divert traffic to fallback pool.
Jia (PM): Heads-up — potential customer impact: API responses slow for some inference calls. Early estimate: ~15% of requests in us-west-2 affected, customers on dedicated capacity may be impacted if pinned.
Sofia (Support): Preparing a short customer note. Draft below — please edit/approve.
Sofia (Support): ```Status: Degraded performance for text generation in us-west-2. We are investigating and routing traffic to fallback capacity. No data loss. ETA for mitigation: 30-60m. Affected customers will see slower responses.```
Marta - Eng: Draft OK. Small tweak: add model name and that dedicated customers may see pinned model degradation. New text: ```Status: Degraded performance for model redwood-13b variants in us-west-2. We are actively routing traffic to fallback pools and increasing capacity. No data loss. ETA for mitigation: 20-45m. Dedicated/pinned deployments may experience reduced throughput.```
Sam (oncall): Alex, steps to mitigate?
Alex (SRE): Running: 
```
# escalate pressure off GPUs
kubectl drain gw-uw2-05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
kubectl cordon gw-uw2-05
```
Alex (SRE): Also pushing autoscale override to +30% for rwd-serving-prod autoscaler.
Marta - Eng: I'm going to enable prefix/KV cache sticky routing for long-context requests to reduce tail. Patching config now.
Sofia (Support): Sending initial customer notification to impacted customers now (templated to support@... list).
Jia (PM): Can we get a quick status page update? Suggested short status page copy: ```Investigating: Elevated latency affecting a subset of text-generation requests in us-west-2. Mitigation steps in progress.```
Marta - Eng: Put that on status page. I'll update once fallback routing is fully live.
Sam (oncall): Monitoring metrics, tails dropping from 1200ms->480ms since routing started. Still above SLO but trending.
Alex (SRE): Node gw-uw2-05 had a stuck process; restarted the inference shim on that host, kernel thread freed. Confirming GPU queues clearing.
Marta - Eng: Fallback pool absorbing traffic, p95 now ~260ms for affected models. Rolling back canary after stability window.
Sam (oncall): Good. I'll keep this thread as runbook. Next: post-mortem owner? Suggest Marta for remediation since config/routing was involved.
Marta - Eng: Happy to own post-mortem. I'll collect logs and timeline.
Jia (PM): I'll coordinate customer follow-up and final status page message.
Sofia (Support): Final customer note draft for post-incident: ```Resolved: The latency issue affecting redwood-13b variants in us-west-2 has been mitigated by routing to fallback capacity and restarting affected hosts. We are continuing a post-incident review to identify root cause and preventive measures. No customer data was lost.```
Sam (oncall): Thanks everyone. Leaving incident channel open for 60m for observations. If anything regresses, re-alert. :thumbsup:
